notes.title: 📢 The Red One: Occultation End of 2nd CBT Soon! 📢
notes.content:
📢 The Red One: Occultation End of 2nd CBT 📢

Dear, Mercenaries.

Thanks to all the love, interest and enthusiastic participation, the 2nd CBT is about to come to an end soon!

[b]🔹 End of CBT Schedule[/b]
📆 Date: Feb 23rd 2025, 14:59 (UTC)

Based on all the feedbacks and suggestions received during the CBT, we will come back with more developments for the official launch!

[b]📌 Post-CBT Notes[/b]
- Game will not be accessible after the end of CBT.

We would like to send our most sincere gratitude for all participants, and will be looking forward to meeting you all upon the official launch! 🚀

Thank you.

notes.title: The Red One: Occultation - Beta Test Announcement
notes.content:
📢 The Red One: Occultation - Beta Test Announcement 📢

Mercenaries, the long-awaited Beta Test is here!
Experience new content and enhanced gameplay firsthand.

🔹 Test Schedule
📅 Feb 20, 09:00 UTC ~ Feb 23, 14:59 UTC

🔹 How to Join
✅ Download  The Red One: Occultation DEMO client
✅ Play freely during the test period

🔹 How to play
✅ [url=https://docs.overtake.world/games/the-red-one-occultation]Play Guide[/url]

🔹The Red One: Occultation DEMO Gameplay Tip
During Quick Party, all members need to be READY for the game to start.
Make sure to press READY for the matchmaking to begin!

✨ Key Features & Improvements in the 2nd CBT
🧟 Zombie Boss added (Extraction Mode)
⚔️ New Arena Map
💥 Enhanced Combat Mechanics
🤝 Party Matching System
🔧 Performance & Balancing Improvements

Your feedback is crucial in shaping the game’s future!
Stay tuned to our official channels for more details.

🎯 Join the Beta Test and get an exclusive first look!
